qorqonaγ-žubur-a: Qorqonaγ-Žubur — Qorqonaq-Jubur, a place name; dative-locative -a, 'at, in' (name + case; Ming 地名) [地名(裏)]
endēče: ene — this; ablative -ēče, 'from here' (pronoun + case, long vowel; endē is the adverb 'here') [這裏(自)]
tümed: tümen — ten thousand, a tümen; plural -d, 'tümens' (numeral noun + plural) [萬每]
morilasu: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb, optative -su, 'let me mount, I will mount' (noun-derived verb, optative, first person) [上馬]
žeġün: žeġün — left (hand or side; Ming 左) (adjective) [左]
morilatuγai: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb, optative -tuγai, 'let him mount' (noun-derived verb, optative, third person) [敎(上)馬]
bolžaγ̇an: bolža- — to appoint, to agree on a meeting (stem inferred; Ming 約會); ending -γ̇an (uncertain), 'appointment' (verb or noun) [約會]
žamuqa-dāča: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; ablative -dāča, 'from Jamuqa' (name + case; long vowel, uncertain) [人名 處]

__broaden__.jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter' · also after kekül(i)- ('one's own tuft'), šibülgel(i)- ('one's own braid') and nidün-dür(i)- ('in one's own eye'), and after the accusative in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen (token ni-jen) · also after bergen(i)- ('one's own sister-in-law') and deġü-ner(i)- ('one's own younger brothers'), where the (i) is Shiratori's accusative; also after köġün(i)- ('one's own son') and ökid(i)- ('one's own daughters') · also -(i)jen after esüg(i)- ('one's own ripe mare's milk') and after -dür(i)- ('to one's own', ulus irgen -dür(i)-jen) · also after emeġel(i)- ('one's own saddle') · also after hüker(i)- ('one's own ox'), güžüġün-dür(i)-, ebčeġün-dür(i)- ('at one's own neck, chest') and üge-dür(i)- ('in one's own word')
__broaden__.jar: -jar — instrumental: with, by means of (case suffix; the token left after moṅgirsun(i)-; the Ming 敎 marks the means) [薤敎] · also in jabuγad(i)-jar, 'on foot' (Ming 步行着, the whole word; the token left after jabuγad(i)-, analysis uncertain)
__broaden__.ja: -(j)a — dative-locative, 'to' (back-vowel form; the j is bracketed, the token left after saγ̇uqu-) [住坐 行] · also in moγai-(j)a, 'like a snake' (Ming 蛇行; the sense 'like' is uncertain)
__broaden__.bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'being about to set off' (neġü- 'move' + -kü + bolun; uncertain)
